# Supplementary tables (generated by `figures/scripts/make_supp_tables.py`; values from saved results only)
- ST1_per_track_metrics_all_models.tsv: 183 test tracks x 9 model/mapping rows (long). Columns `pearson_r`, `pearson_r_squared` (squared Pearson r) and `prediction_R2` (= 1 - SS_res/SS_tot; Borzoi-TL uncalibrated, baselines validation-calibrated, see `prediction_R2_kind`). Mappings: oracle (best test track), valsel (selected on chr1/chr8 validation), valsel_excl_ident (Enformer/AlphaGenome only; identical-experiment candidates excluded; AlphaGenome exclusion is a proxy). Exposure classes from exposure_audit/track_exposure.tsv. All 359 test tiles, chr9+chr22, hg38, 128 bp grid. Sources: results_phase2/exposure_stratified/per_track_metrics_by_exposure.csv, results_phase2/e7_nonoracle/{enformer,alphagenome}/per_track_metrics.csv.
- ST2_exposure_audit_per_track.tsv: verbatim copy of exposure_audit/track_exposure.tsv (183 tracks).
- ST3_allele_matched_variant_summary.tsv (+ ST3b_mpra_label_counts.tsv): counts recomputed from variant_provenance/*.tsv and results_phase2/e2_validation/labels/label_counts.tsv.
- ST4_e2_interim_tables.tsv: stacked interim E2 tables (p1, baselines, secondary_P1, p2) for AlphaGenome and Enformer. INTERIM, unadjusted p, Holm deferred; P2 sign convention unresolved (SD-017).
